The name was derived from the Persian word 'charragah' which means 'torchbearer' or 'luminous'. This name was given to reflect the lighthouse's role in guiding ships safely to the harbor.

historical_references.reference: Cheragh Mosque in Shiraz, Iran, was named after the lighthouse due to its proximity and the similar role it played in guiding people to spiritual enlightenment.
